THE FIRST WORKING CHAPTER

A LITTLE CRAFT.
A NEW WORLD.

A heritage jeweller. A new lab-grown diamond brand. My first glimpse of how a story takes shape across every touchpoint.

CHANDIGARH · FIELD NOTES

From heritage
to JAZAA

At Sant Ram’s, I joined the story of JAZAA, a new jewellery brand rooted in a long-standing family legacy. The challenge was to give its contemporary identity room to shine while making the experience feel considered and easy to explore.

As a visual communication intern, I worked across brand identity, product photography and the information architecture for JAZAA’s website. It was my first experience of seeing how a brand’s details come together—from the image someone notices to the path they follow next.

FROM THE WORLD OF DESIGNVOL. III · JANITRI

A CHAPTER ABOUT CARE

DESIGNING
FOR CARE.

A maternal healthcare team, a hospital ward and a closer look at what nurses need when every detail matters.

BENGALURU · FIELD NOTES

Listening
before designing

At Janitri, my graduation project began with hospital visits and conversations with nurses. Their work involved bringing together patient details, observations and early-warning scores while moving through a busy care setting.

I designed Matera, a tablet-first antenatal care experience, bringing a patient’s context and the next action closer together. The work included research, flows, a design system and a prototype shaped around the people using it.

AS SEEN ON SHARK TANK INDIA

A pitch for
better care

Founder Arun Agarwal presented Janitri’s maternal and fetal monitoring technology on Shark Tank India Season 2, securing an offer from Namita Thapar.
